# Phase 1 Type Model — Remove `any` Casts

**Branch**: `071-remove-any-casts`
**Date**: 2026-04-15

This feature produces no new runtime data model. It introduces (and strengthens) **type-level entities**. Each entry below lists: name, origin, shape summary, validation boundary (if any), and replacement target (which `any`s it eliminates).

---

## T-1: `Database`

**Origin**: generated by `bunx supabase gen types typescript --linked`
**Location**: `src/types/database.ts` (new canonical path; replaces `src/lib/supabase/database.types.ts`)
**Shape**: root type with `public.Tables`, `public.Views`, `public.Functions`, `public.Enums`. One sub-type per migration-defined object.
**Validation boundary**: none — this is machine-truth from the DB.
**Replaces**: every `(supabase as any).from(...)`, every `(serviceClient as any).from(...)`, every `.rpc('name' as never, … as never)` (at least the cast half).

Regeneration rule: MUST be re-run in the same commit as any new migration under `supabase/migrations/`. A follow-up CI gate (out of scope for this feature, tracked separately) will enforce this.

---

## T-2: `TypedSupabaseClient` & `TypedServiceClient`

**Origin**: `SupabaseClient<Database>` re-exported as named aliases for readability.
**Location**: `src/lib/supabase/server.ts` (re-export), `src/lib/supabase/client.ts` (browser variant).
**Shape**:

```ts
export type TypedSupabaseClient = SupabaseClient<Database>
export type TypedServiceClient = SupabaseClient<Database> // same shape; alias emphasises caller intent
```

**Validation boundary**: none.
**Replaces**: ~60 `as any` casts in `src/app/api/**` handlers and library wrappers.

---

## T-3: `StudioDatabase` (optional — decided at P3 start)

**Origin**: either generated from the legacy studio Supabase project (if >5 tables), or hand-typed (if ≤5 tables we use).
**Location**: `src/lib/supabase/studio-database.types.ts`.
**Shape**: subset of legacy studio schema; only tables we actually touch (`product_catalog`, plus at most 4 others).
**Validation boundary**: none.
**Replaces**: 7 `as any` casts inside `useProductCatalog.ts` + any callers of `studioSupabase` that cast to reach the typed table map.

---

## T-4: `CanvasProduct`

**Origin**: hand-written in `src/components/asset-studio/types.ts`.
**Shape (draft)**:

```ts
export interface CanvasProduct {
  id: string
  productId: string
  name: string
  sku: string | null
  imageUrl: string | null
  /** Only set when the product came from a real store sync */
  source: 'seed' | 'nuvemshop' | 'manual'
}
```

**Validation boundary**: at `tasks.artifact_data.activeProduct` read site — a `zod` schema parses the JSON before it enters React state.
**Replaces**: ~30 `any` usages around product-selection code in the modal.

---

## T-5: `CanvasState` & `CanvasAction`

**Origin**: hand-written in `src/components/asset-studio/types.ts`.
**Shape (draft)**:

```ts
export interface CanvasState {
  channel: ChannelAspectRatio
  heading: string
  description: string
  cta: string
  style: CanvasStyle
  product: CanvasProduct | null
  isCarouselMode: boolean
  textColor: string
  ctaColor: string
  overlayOpacity: number
  font: CanvasFont
  widgets: CanvasWidget[]
}

export type CanvasAction =
  | { type: 'set_heading'; value: string }
  | { type: 'set_text_color'; value: string }
  | { type: 'set_font'; value: CanvasFont }
  | { type: 'set_channel'; value: ChannelAspectRatio }
  | { type: 'add_widget'; value: CanvasWidget }
/* … exhaustive list derived from the action catalogue in studio/chat system prompt … */
```

**Validation boundary**: at `dispatch()` call site, TypeScript's discriminated-union narrowing does the work. No runtime `zod` needed for in-memory dispatch.
**Replaces**: ~40 `any` usages in the reducer and its consumers.

## T-6: `ChannelAspectRatio`, `CanvasStyle`, `CanvasFont`, `CanvasWidget`

**Origin**: hand-written unions in `src/components/asset-studio/types.ts`.
**Shape**: string literal unions mirroring the `studio-chat` system-prompt constants. Example:

```ts
export type ChannelAspectRatio =
  | '9:16'
  | '1:1'
  | '4:5'
  | '16:9'
  | '2:3'
  | '3:4'
  | '1:2'
  | '3:2'
  | '4:3'
export type CanvasFont =
  | 'inter'
  | 'poppins'
  | 'montserrat'
  | 'playfair'
  | 'lora'
  | 'cormorant'
  | 'bebas'
  | 'oswald'
  | 'anton'
  | 'dancing-script'
  | 'great-vibes'
  | 'pacifico'
  | 'dm-serif'
  | 'fraunces'
  | 'space-grotesk'
  | 'raleway'
```

**Validation boundary**: at API-route body parse (`/api/studio/chat`) — a `zod` enum mirrors the TypeScript union.
**Replaces**: ~15 `any`s scattered across style helpers and font pickers.

## T-7: `AssetCreatorModalProps`

**Origin**: hand-written in `src/components/asset-studio/types.ts`.
**Shape**: full prop interface for the modal. Lists every callback, initial state chunk, and presentation flag the modal accepts.
**Validation boundary**: TypeScript at caller.
**Replaces**: ~20 `any`s in the modal signature and inside helper components that accept passthrough props.

---

## T-8: Per-RPC argument types

**Origin**: re-exports from `Database['public']['Functions'][<name>]['Args']` and `['Returns']`.
**Location**: co-located thin wrappers:

| RPC                             | Wrapper                                                              |
| ------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `increment_ai_credits`          | `src/lib/billing/rpc.ts` → `incrementAiCredits({ teamId, credits })` |
| `create_task_with_conversation` | `src/lib/tasks/rpc.ts` → `createTaskWithConversation(payload)`       |
| `activate_skill`                | `src/lib/actions/skills.ts` → `activateSkill({ teamId, slug })`      |
| `unschedule_cron_job`           | `src/lib/actions/workspace.ts` → `unscheduleCronJob(name)`           |
| `update_agent_config`           | `src/lib/actions/agents.ts` → `updateAgentConfig(params)`            |
| custom module RPC               | `src/lib/modules/provision.ts` (co-located)                          |

**Validation boundary**: wrapper signature is the boundary. Callers get full type checks.
**Replaces**: 10 `any`/`never` casts around RPC invocations.

---

## Type taxonomy for remaining exceptions

Any `any` that survives the refactor MUST carry one of three comments (see FR-009). This doc is the authoritative definition:

| Marker                             | When to use                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `// any: upstream-sdk`             | Third-party SDK emits an untyped value we cannot round-trip without extra runtime cost. Example: older `composio-core` return types.                                                     |
| `// any: generated-types-mismatch` | A migration adds something Supabase's type generator can't express (e.g., a complex `jsonb` shape we hand-validate). Must be paired with a tracked issue so the drift eventually clears. |
| `// any: test-fixture`             | Only under `src/**/__tests__/*`. Excluded from the <20 budget.                                                                                                                           |

---

## Non-entities (explicitly rejected)

These were considered and left out per Principle V:

- ❌ A custom `SafeSelect<T>` helper type. The generated `Database` already narrows `.select('col')` return types. Adding another helper hides where the errors really originate.
- ❌ A runtime "deep-type-audit" script that flags untyped Supabase queries. `tsc --noEmit` already does this once `as any` is gone.
- ❌ A migration to unify `database.types.ts` path. The only move is the file location; no code generation change.
